scope: Full existing serial Metal suite plus CPU per-shape quadrature/preparation and balanced-inventory checks. Synthetic CPU tables verify selection logic only, not Hostun force accuracy.

gates.reference: Require passing source-stable complete unique pose inventory; recompute 2% finest-change gate; candidate strictly coarser than reference
gates.selection: Minimum Gauss3 level2..4 meeting every pose at target5%; explicit error if unavailable
gates.preparation: Preserve source vertices, faces, field, origin, inertia, mass geometry and measure; new stable sample identity
gates.binding: Reject protocol, physical library or archived source hash change before producing output
gates.inventory: Balanced sampling includes every shape with counts differing by at most one; deterministic seed; nonoverlap; default random sequence unchanged

regression: All existing assertions retained; actual Atlas Python/browser request consumers; rendering opt-in unchanged
